content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices can sometimes lead to skin irritations, such as contact dermatitis. These reactions may occur due to the adhesive patches used to secure the device or the materials within the sensor itself. Allergic reactions, particularly to specific adhesives, should be identified and managed to enhance the comfort of using these devices. The Panther Program provides multilingual resources to assist individuals who experience skin-related issues associated with CGM devices.
